Au sein de l'entité Digital Power R&D, vous rejoignez une équipe en charge du développement de la Power Logic Engineering Suite (PLES) : une plateforme d'ingénierie stratégique visant à unifier la configuration d'un écosystème complet d'équipements industriels (protection, mesure, contrôle).

Ce programme s'inscrit dans un environnement :

  • international (équipes réparties en Europe, Inde, Chine, Amérique du Nord)
  • multi-produits et multi-business
  • à forte complexité technique (systèmes interconnectés, infrastructures critiques)

La plateforme vise à remplacer une multitude d'outils existants par une solution unique, cohérente et scalable, au service d'applications critiques où la continuité de service est essentielle (ex : hôpitaux, infrastructures industrielles).

Votre rôle

Rattaché(e) au Directeur Digital Power R&D, vous intervenez comme Lead Product Owner au niveau système, avec un rôle clé dans le pilotage global du produit.

Vous êtes responsable de :
  • la vision produit à l'échelle plateforme
  • la cohérence fonctionnelle globale
  • l'alignement entre enjeux business, technique et expérience utilisateur

Vous évoluez dans un rôle de leadership transverse, sans management hiérarchique direct, en coordination avec des Product Owner, architectes systèmes, équipes de développement, stakeholders métiers.

Vos missions

Piloter la vision produit à l'échelle système
  • Définir et porter la vision globale de la plateforme PLES
  • Garantir une expérience utilisateur cohérente sur un écosystème multi-produits
  • Assurer l'alignement entre stratégie business, contraintes techniques et besoins utilisateurs


Piloter et arbitrer le backlog global
  • Structurer, maintenir et prioriser le Portfolio Backlog
  • Décomposer les epics en features et animer les sessions de refinement
  • Arbitrer entre des priorités business concurrentes dans un environnement complexe
  • Prendre des décisions produit en intégrant dépendances, risques et valeur
Coordonner un écosystème international
  • Fédérer des équipes distribuées à l'échelle mondiale (~60+ personnes)
  • Coordonner plusieurs squads avec des rattachements et enjeux différents
  • Assurer l'alignement entre stakeholders multi-business et multiculturels
  • Piloter les interactions entre équipes pour garantir une vision produit unifiée
Opérer dans un environnement Agile à grande échelle (SAFe)
  • Préparer et contribuer aux événements clés (PI Planning, synchronisation, démonstrations)
  • Garantir la qualité et la maturité des backlogs avant exécution
  • Contribuer à la définition des objectifs PI et au suivi de leur réalisation
  • Assurer la cohérence globale des plans d'exécution
Gérer la complexité technique et système
  • Comprendre les interactions entre équipements, systèmes et architecture
  • Anticiper les impacts techniques des décisions produit
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les architectes et équipes engineering
  • Contribuer à la cohérence globale du système et éviter des approches fragmentées


Votre profil

Expérience significative (10+ ans) en Product Owner ou Product Manager

Expérience dans des environnements : complexes, multi-équipes, internationaux

Expérience sur des produits techniques ou systèmes (industrie, énergie, IoT, software complexe...)

Compétences clés
  • Maîtrise des méthodes Agile à grande échelle (SAFe ou équivalent)
  • Capacité à piloter un produit à l'échelle système / programme
  • Forte capacité de priorisation et d'arbitrage
  • Bonne compréhension technique indispensable (interactions systèmes, architecture)
Soft skills
  • Leadership transverse et capacité d'influence
  • Capacité à fédérer dans un contexte sans autorité hiérarchique
  • Aisance dans des environnements multiculturels
  • Solide capacité à gérer la complexité et l'incertitude
Langues
  • Français et anglais courants (obligatoire)

Position Summary...

What you'll do...

Senior Manager, UX Design - Core Ecommerce

Location:San Bruno, CA

About the Team

Join our award-winning design team and help shape the future of retail. Our mission is to bring dignity and access to all through design excellenceregardless of zip code or bank account. We design compelling experiences that improve the daily lives of millions of customers, whether at home, in-store, or on the go.

As part of the design team at the forefront of retail innovation, you'll help build best-in-class experiences that drive continuous improvement for one of the worlds largest companies. If youre motivated by complex challenges and want to redefine commerce and consumer services, a design role at Walmart could be the opportunity youve been looking for.

About the Role

As aSenior UX Manager on the Core Ecommerce team, you will lead a team to articulate the strategy and design for key parts of the Walmart.com and mobile app shopping experiences, focused on building and mentoring your team and workflow for high impact results. You will use your deep understanding of consumer app patterns and retail experiences to transform how our customers complete their shopping missions in our app and on our site. You'll be accountable for the craft and timely delivery of your teams work, and you'll own and present a strong design POV within your partner set to shape market-leading solutions via the product roadmap.

You'll sweep us off our feet if you have...

  • Excellent visual and interaction design skills and a keen understanding of trendsin and out of retail.
  • An ability to communicate concepts in a clear and compelling way to audiences of all levels of understanding and levels of seniority.
  • A demonstrable understanding of ecommerce and deep experience building experiences that drive revenue.
  • A strong design aesthetic that brings together brand expressions and systems thinking. You practice universal design.
  • Deep experience with business requirement gathering, end-to-journey mapping, facilitating sessions like Design Sprints, conducting competitive analysis, and leading rapid concepting and prototyping.
  • Comfort with ambiguity along with an ability to motive teams and partners.
  • Ability to consume deep strategic data and insights to produce meaningful experiences for customers and members.
  • A demonstrable track record working cross-functionally with shipping successful products in a fast-paced environment. You thrive in an ever-changing environment.
  • A strategic mindset and asystemthinking approach to taking the complex and make it simple.
  • Find joy in leading by doing. You inspire, coach, and contribute to our team culture.
  • A self-starter mindset who is well organized and always looking to improve things.

You'll make an impact by:

  • Designing at the highest level of craftfor a broad population of Walmart customers.
  • Facilitating creative problem-solving across cross-functional partners to drive best-in-class thinking from all parts of the organization and seamlessly integrating competitive organizational goals.
  • Proactively soliciting, leveraging, and sharing design research, competitive research, data, and analytics to create full-featured and strategic products.
  • Owning and driving a program of work and collaborating seamlessly with cross-functional partners.
  • Recruiting the best design talent and mentoring our growing team.
  • Thinking holistically so that we build true end-to-end experiences.
  • Multitasking across different projects and adapting to changing priorities.
  • Championing the Design Thinking philosophy throughout the business.
  • Communicating effectively with kindness and empathy.

Preferred qualifications:

  • DegreeinHCI,Information Architecture,DigitalDesign,or similar and 7+ years of experience in product design.
  • Have afantastic portfolio of elegant design solutions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication.

jobs.contents:
Content designers at Meta craft simple, straightforward and human experiences. Approaching design through the lens of language, we leverage our expertise in user experience design, design thinking and product strategy. Come join our team to create and shape great, intuitive products and services used by billions of people around the world every day.You'll be expected to design and deliver product flows, new features, in-product language, content frameworks, navigation, product naming and more, for platforms including mobile, desktop, AR/VR, hardware and voice. The Meta Content Design team is one of the largest and most established in the world, and includes people at various stages in their careers and from a range of backgrounds.

Content Designer Responsibilities:

  • Design, write, edit and test clear, compelling in-product language to help users and teams meet their goals. This includes product flows, interface language, education materials, product names, navigational nomenclature, terminology, taxonomies and other content across Meta products and experiences.
  • Apply systems thinking to the product, whether it's defining extensible design system guidance, conducting audits of existing experiences or creating information architecture.
  • Use your familiarity with how code works in software. This may involve doing things like reviewing code to ensure the in-product language is as intended, or creating the logic to personalize the experience for a user.
  • Give and solicit feedback from your UX design peers in service of building the best products.
  • Create or contribute to high-fidelity design mocks using Figma.
  • Collaborate daily with peers across disciplines, including engineering, design, research, marketing and data science, to take products from conception to launch.
  • Partner with our internationalization team to ensure product experiences are of the highest quality in every language.
  • Demonstrate sound judgment and help shape product narratives, along with team direction and strategy.
  • Independently and proactively identify and work on projects that span multiple teams.
Minimum Qualifications:
  • 5+ years' experience in UX writing.
  • Examples of finished wireframes, or design mocks co-authored using design tools, that have been used to drive decision-making within a team.
  • Experience simplifying and communicating complex ideas to broad audiences in a compelling way.
  • Familiarity with tools for managing and updating content at scale.
  • Examples of work in design systems and systems thinking.
  • Demonstrated experience leading projects with minimal direction and handling a large degree of ambiguity.
About Meta:

Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today-beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.

Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Meta participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law. Please note that Meta may leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies in connection with applications for employment.

Meta is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations-ext@fb.com.

$118,000/year to $167,000/year + bonus + equity + benefits

Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

Position Summary...

The Creative Director leads the vision and execution of major storytelling campaigns like Back to School and Holiday, crafting emotionally resonant, culturally relevant narratives across all channels. This role requires a concept-first thinker with a strong portfolio in omni-channel advertising, capable of managing both internal creative teams and external agency partners. Responsibilities include strategic leadership, team development, cross-functional collaboration, and full campaign oversight from ideation through post-production. The ideal candidate brings over 12 years of experience in high-level conceptual advertising, blending hands-on creative skills with strong leadership and a deep understanding of consumer behavior in retail. Proficiency in tools like Adobe Creative Suite, Figma, and Google Slides is essential, along with a passion for trend-driven, human-centered storytelling.

What you'll do...

  • Strategic Leadership: Define and drive the creative vision for seasonal brand campaigns, aligning with overall brand strategy as well as enterprise and seasonal initiatives as necessary.
  • Team management: Manage, build and coach a multidisciplinary team of creatives providing guidance, contextual feedback and support to foster creative excellence.

o Mentor, guide, and grow the team with optimism and enthusiasm, pursuing an award-winning in-house agency model.

o Conduct semi-annual or annual performance evaluations with the goal to up-level our creative output; building skillsets such as: conceptual capabilities, ideating, presentation, creative/strategic alignment, public speaking, and critical thinking.

o Identify new, competitive talent to add to the growing team.

  • Collaboration: Work closely with senior leadership, marketing strategy, insights & planning, production, and other key stakeholders to craft campaigns that inspire, sustain and grow business.

o Pursue ways that we can work better, faster.

o Manage team and projects that are on-brief, strategic, creative, and comprehensive for presentations - mitigating feedback, ultimately keeping workstreams on track.

o Partner with Creative Account Management and Operations and Production to manage timelines and executions to concept breakthrough creative on schedule and on budget.

o Build strong relationships with Marketing and peer teams to accelerate team expertise & growth; sustain and grow business.

  • Enterprise Brand Cohesion:

    • Ensure all creative output is considered at various levels of the funnel
  • Ensure connection across all channels and touchpoints. Work towards the shared goal of greater brand attribution and recall.
  • Project Oversight: Manage campaign projects from inception to completion, ensuring timely delivery and alignment with strategic objectives.

o Lead the ideation of strategic, highly relatable & engaging concepts, leveraging relevant swipe crafting persuasive decks and adlobs, present to key stakeholders and executives, work with the team to create all pre-production decks, be integral to the casting and selection of talent/crews to bring our vision alive (directors, photographers, stylists, etc.), execute on set, direct post-production processes overseeing the edit, color, sound, and design of all post-shoot assets, and be accountable for final delivery of asset suites.

o Employ critical thinking to ensure we're always on task. Take feedback and craft clear, actionable directions with context for teams.

  • Trend Awareness: Stay abreast of industry trends, culture and emerging design technologies incorporating relevant trends into brand concepts.

Qualifications

  • Proven experience as a Creative Director in the advertising or retail industry.
  • Exceptional portfolio demonstrating idea-first, human-centered, dialogue-driven ad campaigns.
  • Breakthrough and branded 360/omni channel examples for large-scale enterprises/clients.
  • Strong leadership, collaboration and interpersonal skills, with the ability to inspire, motivate and lead a creative team and partner with agency creatives.
  • Excellent understanding of consumer behavior within a retail landscape.
  • 12+ years of experience in conceptual campaign advertising, with a proven track record of leadership and successful project management at a high-level.
  • Proficiency in industry-standard design tools and software including the Adobe Creative Suite, Microsoft Office, Google Slides, Slack and Figma.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment leading brand design work in-house or agency side.
  • Bachelor or masters degree in graphic design, advertising, brand strategy, or a related field.

Reporting:

  • Reports to Group Creative Director
  • Manages team responsible for Seasonal Brand Campaigns, including Associate Creative Directors, Senior Designers, Art Directors, Writers and Designers
  • In office

Why Join Us:

  • You are a creative leader with a flair for thoughtful, conceptual and breakthrough storytelling - no matter how small the ad, or large the megaphone - and a track record of delivering exceptional results. We invite you to apply and be part of our journey to redefine the retail landscape, and help shape the future of our team!
  • A dynamic and collaborative work environment with a thrilling job to be done: make Walmart relevant to every American via world-class creativity and craft.
  • Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development within a global industry leader.

About Walmart Marketing

Named Ad Age's Marketer of the Year in 2022, you'll join an internationally recognized team of thinkers, creators, and problem solvers passionate about helping people save money and live better.

Walmart Marketing is a dynamic, multidimensional organization dedicated to redefining how the world shops through impactful creative and fast-paced innovation - all grounded in customer insights and brand strategy. We live out our company values each day while striving to exceed customer expectations and drive growth for the company.

We orchestrate marketing campaigns and experiences that reach millions of daily shoppers. Our work spans the digital and physical spaces and combines the work of numerous internal teams and external advertising and media agencies. Our teams work together to show our customers how they can save money and live better. If you are motivated by complex challenges and want to build the future of commerce and consumer services, a Marketing role at Walmart could be what you've been looking for.

Join Walmart and your work could help over 275 million global customers live better every week. Yes, we are the Fortune #1 company. But you'll quickly find we're a company who wants you to feel comfortable bringing your whole self to work. A career at Walmart is where the world's most complex challenges meet a kinder way of life. Our mission spreads far beyond the walls of our stores. Join us and you'll discover why we are a world leader in sustainability, and community involvement. Position Summary...

Sam's Club aims to turn merchandising into a predictive engine that keeps shelves full, costs low, and experiences effortless. The Director of Experience Strategy - Merchandising will drive the transformation of merchandising and product placement systems to create seamless, efficient, and intelligent experiences for associates, suppliers, and internal business partners. This role focuses on designing end-to-end merchandising experiences that reduce friction, anticipate needs, and leverage emerging technologies such as AI and agentive systems to improve accuracy, efficiency, and business value.

What you'll do...

What You'll Do

  • Reimagine Merchandising Journeys - Within 6 months, design a unified merchandising experience strategy that improves decision-making, reduces inefficiencies, and optimizes product availability.


  • Integrate AI & Intelligent Systems - Partner with business, product and engineering to pilot agentive tools that streamline ordering, forecasting, and product placement decisions. Deliver at least one AI-driven merchandising initiative in the first year.


  • Lead Cross-Functional Squads - Facilitate squads that connect business, design, and product to solve critical B2B challenges. Establish measurable outcomes tied to improve in-stock performance, supplier efficiency, and cost savings.


  • Future-Focused Innovation - Develop a merchandising blueprint that looks 2-3 years ahead, showing how advanced systems and intelligent agents will shape the future of supply chain experience.


  • Measure Outcomes - Define KPIs for system usability, error reduction, and efficiency gains; continuously iterate based on data and feedback.

What You'll Bring

  • Provent track record in B2B, Enterprise, SAAS, operational, or supply chain design systems.


  • Proven ability to design complex workflows and simplify associate/supplier interactions.


  • Exposure to AI/agentive technologies with a focus on systems automation and decision support.


  • Strong design thinking facilitation skills to align diverse technical and business stakeholders.


  • Experience integrating research insights into product roadmaps and operational workflows.


  • Leadership skills to mentor teams and drive large-scale transformation initiatives.


  • Expert in driving stellar design execution with cohesive and connected experiences to ensure we deliver our experience principles to meet user needs and business goals.

Apple's Vision Products Group is looking for a strategic product design leader to help define the future of health, wellbeing, and fitness experiences across vision products. You will translate ambiguous opportunities at the intersection of spatial computing, wearables, consumer health, and human behavior into clear first-party product direction by identifying high-impact opportunities, shaping early concepts, defining what should be built, and helping cross-functional teams bring those experiences to life.

The ideal candidate is a product leader who thinks deeply and works concretely, turning complexity into direction. They have helped build consumer health, wellbeing, or fitness products, and they know how to balance customer impact, behavioral insight, technical feasibility, and design quality. They are equally comfortable framing a new opportunity, working through tradeoffs with design and engineering, synthesizing user and market signals, and leading executive conversations that drive clarity and alignment.

Description

This role connects strategy to execution. You will identify the health, wellbeing, and fitness opportunities with the greatest potential for customer impact, shape first-party experiences, and help teams move from exploratory ideas to validated product direction. You will bring strong product judgment to emerging technologies and new interaction modalities, including spatial computing, sensor-driven experiences, personalization, and multimodal interfaces, staying close to prototypes, user insights, and technical constraints so that direction becomes experiences that can be designed, built, tested, and delivered.

You are a systems thinker, clear communicator, and cross-functional leader who operates effectively through ambiguity in a highly collaborative and ownership-oriented manner. You can synthesize complex information, identify the decision that needs to be made, and bring teams together around a clear path forward. If you are curious, energized by ambiguity, and motivated by the opportunity to help millions of people live healthier, more active lives through thoughtfully designed products, we would love to hear from you.

Responsibilities:

Define first-party health, wellbeing, and fitness experiences for vision products, from early opportunity framing through concept, validation, and delivery

 Translate customer needs, behavioral insights, market and technology trends, and Apple product strategy into clear, prioritized product direction

Partner with Product Design, clinical, research, hardware, software, and engineering teams to shape concepts and feature priorities, evaluate feasibility, and align on what should be built

 Lead early-stage exploration, including ideation, prototyping, validation planning, and synthesis of learnings into actionable recommendations

Develop product narratives, opportunity briefs, and strategic frameworks, and define success criteria spanning customer value, behavioral impact, product quality, and technical feasibility

 Facilitate strategic discussions and lead executive reviews, distilling complex product, technical, clinical, and customer information into clear recommendations and decision points

Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external partners across health, fitness, design, research, and product development

Preferred Qualifications

 Experience with spatial computing, wearables, AR/VR, or emerging hardware platforms

Experience building or shaping first-party consumer product experiences

 Experience developing and validating digital health or fitness products alongside clinical, hardware, software, design, and research counterparts

Familiarity with sensor-driven experiences, personalization, multimodal interfaces, or adaptive product experiences

 Advanced degree in product design, human-computer interaction, behavioral science, health sciences, engineering, or a related field

Minimum Qualifications

8+ years of experience in product strategy, product management, product design, or a related product leadership role

 Experience defining, developing, or validating consumer health, wellbeing, fitness, or behavior-change products

Demonstrated ability to move from ambiguous, early-stage opportunity spaces to clear product direction and cross-functional execution

 Strong product judgment, balancing customer value, technical feasibility, design quality, and long-term product strategy

Excellent communication, storytelling, and stakeholder management skills, with experience leading through influence in complex, cross-functional environments

 Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

Pay & Benefits

At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $184,700 and $324,800, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.

Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses - including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits

Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

We are seeking a Training & Quality Specialist to directly support our Prompt Engineering team, which is responsible for crafting and optimizing prompts that guide Al models toward high-quality outputs. This role is critical in maintaining the consistency, accuracy, and excellence of prompt writing through targeted quality auditing, data-driven insights, and impactful training initiatives. As a key partner to the Prompt Writers, you will be responsible for evaluating written outputs for alignment with internal guidelines, conducting root-cause analysis to identify trends or gaps, and developing responsive training materials to address areas for improvement. Hi, we're Oscar. We're hiring an Associate, Insurance Product & Benefit Execution to join our Insurance Product Development team.

Oscar is the first health insurance company built around a full stack technology platform and a relentless focus on serving our members. We started Oscar in 2012 to create the kind of health insurance company we would want for ourselves-one that behaves like a doctor in the family.

About the Role:

The Associate, Insurance Product & Benefit Execution supports the development and delivery of insurance product filings by owning product-specific components of the regulatory filing process for ACA Individual and Small Group (QHP).

This role partners closely with product managers, actuarial, compliance, technology and regulatory operational teams to translate product designs into required filing outputs, leveraging internal systems and tools. The Associate is responsible for ensuring accuracy, consistency, and completeness of product related filing materials, as well as supporting responses to regulatory objections and updates.

This position plays a critical role in enabling timely, high-quality filings by coordinating across teams, managing key deliverables, and maintaining strong operational discipline throughout the filing lifecycle.

You will report into the Vice President, Insurance Product Innovation and Development

Work Location: This is a remote / work-from-home role. You must reside in one of the following states: Arizona, California, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Massachusetts, Michigan, Nevada, New Jersey, New York, North Carolina, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Texas, or Virginia. Note, this list of states is subject to change. #LI-Remote

Pay Transparency: The base pay for this role is: $101,844 - $133,670 per year in New Jersey, New York, and California. The base pay for all other locations is: $91,659 - $120,303 per year. You are also eligible for employee benefits, participation in Oscar's unlimited vacation program, and annual performance bonuses.

Responsibilities:

Product Filing Execution

  • Support development of product-specific components of ACA filings, including benefits, cost-sharing structures, and plan design attributes
  • Translate product designs into required formats using internal systems and tools to support simpler filings (e.g., portfolio filing extract tools)
  • Ensure accuracy and alignment of product data across filing artifacts and internal systems
  • Partner with product managers to validate plan designs and resolve system discrepancies

Regulatory Objections & Updates
  • Support analysis and resolution of regulatory objections, including DOI and CMS feedback
  • Coordinate with Insurance Product, Technology, Compliance, and Actuarial teams to develop and implement required updates
  • Execute against objections, timelines, and resolutions to ensure timely responses
  • Maintain documentation of changes and decisions for audibility and consistency

Cross-Functional Coordination
  • Partner with Product, Actuarial, Technology, and Compliance teams to gather inputs and align on filing related deliverables
  • Communicate requirements, timelines, and dependencies clearly across stakeholders
  • Support alignment between product design and downstream filing / implementation processes

Operational Execution & Process Support
  • Maintain trackers and documentation to monitor filing deliverables, dependencies, and timelines
  • Ensure completion and quality of assigned deliverables across multiple markets
  • Identify inconsistencies, risks, or gaps in product data and escalate as needed
  • Support continuous improvement of filing workflows, tools, and documentation processes

Data Integrity & Quality Assurance
  • Validate product data across systems and filing outputs to ensure consistency and compliance with internal processes
  • Support QA processes for product-related filing components prior to submission
  • Assist in auditing outputs to ensure alignment with approved product designs
  • Ensure compliance with all applicable laws and regulations
  • Other duties as assigned

Requirements:
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Healthcare, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, Finance, or related field or equivalent work experience
  • 3+ years of experience in product, analytics, strategy, consulting, or insurance-related roles
  • Exposure to ACA individual and QHP products (including Small Group)
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple deliverables simultaneously
  • Ability to work cross-functionally in a fast-paced, deadline driven environment
  • Experience operating in cross-functional, fast-paced environments
  • Strong analytical, structured problem-solving, and communication skills
  • Willingness to travel to 25% of the time.

Bonus Points:
  • Familiarity with ACA plan design concepts (e.g., EHB's, limit language)
  • Experience with Oscar internal product configuration and filing systems
  • Experience managing trackers, deliverables, and project coordination tasks
  • Strong excel and data management skills

As a Global Head of Digital Performance at JPMorganChase within Asset & Wealth Management, you will lead the strategy and execution of the firm's digital client experience performance agenda across websites, campaigns, and mobile experiences. You will partner closely with Marketing, Technology, and business leaders to translate client insights into measurable improvements in engagement, conversion, and return on investment. You will build a culture of experimentation and continuous optimization while scaling innovation through structured pilots and vendor partnerships.

Job responsibilities

  • Define and execute a global digital client experience performance strategy that improves engagement, conversion, and relationship depth across key audiences and markets
  • Drive ongoing digital transformation initiatives that modernize digital marketing workflows, tooling, and the quality and consistency of client-facing experiences
  • Own website performance targets and lead continuous improvement through data-driven roadmaps in partnership with user experience and technology teams
  • Partner with marketing stakeholders to design and deliver high-performing campaign landing experiences from intake through measurement and post-campaign insights
  • Lead optimization and experimentation programs, including A/B testing, behavioral analytics, and user research, to continuously raise performance standards
  • Integrate digital performance capabilities with marketing automation and analytics to enable connected, data-driven, and scalable execution
  • Manage and develop a multidisciplinary team across digital marketing, analytics, and user research, fostering a high-performance and inclusive culture
  • Run structured proof-of-concepts and pilots with external vendors, translating results into business cases and scaled solutions with measurable outcomes

  • Proven track record of delivering measurable improvements in website performance, campaign effectiveness, conversion, and return on investment
  • Advanced analytics capability, including the ability to use tools such as Google Analytics to define success metrics, generate insights, and guide prioritization
  • Experience building experimentation programs (for example, A/B testing and user research) and operationalizing learnings into scalable improvements
  • Demonstrated leadership experience managing and developing multidisciplinary teams, including setting strategy, operating rhythms, and performance expectations
  • Strong vendor and partner management experience, including running evaluations, proof-of-concepts, and measurable pilot programs

Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills

  • Familiarity with marketing technology ecosystems, including integration patterns across analytics, content, and campaign platforms
  • Experience partnering with design and engineering teams to deliver scalable template systems and performance-focused user experience improvements

Apple's Vision Products Group is looking for a strategic product design leader to help define the future of health, wellbeing, and fitness experiences across vision products. You will translate ambiguous opportunities at the intersection of spatial computing, wearables, consumer health, and human behavior into clear first-party product direction by identifying high-impact opportunities, shaping early concepts, defining what should be built, and helping cross-functional teams bring those experiences to life.

The ideal candidate is a product leader who thinks deeply and works concretely, turning complexity into direction. They have helped build consumer health, wellbeing, or fitness products, and they know how to balance customer impact, behavioral insight, technical feasibility, and design quality. They are equally comfortable framing a new opportunity, working through tradeoffs with design and engineering, synthesizing user and market signals, and leading executive conversations that drive clarity and alignment.

Description

This role connects strategy to execution. You will identify the health, wellbeing, and fitness opportunities with the greatest potential for customer impact, shape first-party experiences, and help teams move from exploratory ideas to validated product direction. You will bring strong product judgment to emerging technologies and new interaction modalities, including spatial computing, sensor-driven experiences, personalization, and multimodal interfaces, staying close to prototypes, user insights, and technical constraints so that direction becomes experiences that can be designed, built, tested, and delivered.

You are a systems thinker, clear communicator, and cross-functional leader who operates effectively through ambiguity in a highly collaborative and ownership-oriented manner. You can synthesize complex information, identify the decision that needs to be made, and bring teams together around a clear path forward. If you are curious, energized by ambiguity, and motivated by the opportunity to help millions of people live healthier, more active lives through thoughtfully designed products, we would love to hear from you.

Responsibilities:

Define first-party health, wellbeing, and fitness experiences for vision products, from early opportunity framing through concept, validation, and delivery

 Translate customer needs, behavioral insights, market and technology trends, and Apple product strategy into clear, prioritized product direction

Partner with Product Design, clinical, research, hardware, software, and engineering teams to shape concepts and feature priorities, evaluate feasibility, and align on what should be built

 Lead early-stage exploration, including ideation, prototyping, validation planning, and synthesis of learnings into actionable recommendations

Develop product narratives, opportunity briefs, and strategic frameworks, and define success criteria spanning customer value, behavioral impact, product quality, and technical feasibility

 Facilitate strategic discussions and lead executive reviews, distilling complex product, technical, clinical, and customer information into clear recommendations and decision points

Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external partners across health, fitness, design, research, and product development

Preferred Qualifications

 Experience with spatial computing, wearables, AR/VR, or emerging hardware platforms

Experience building or shaping first-party consumer product experiences

 Experience developing and validating digital health or fitness products alongside clinical, hardware, software, design, and research counterparts

Familiarity with sensor-driven experiences, personalization, multimodal interfaces, or adaptive product experiences

 Advanced degree in product design, human-computer interaction, behavioral science, health sciences, engineering, or a related field

Minimum Qualifications

8+ years of experience in product strategy, product management, product design, or a related product leadership role

 Experience defining, developing, or validating consumer health, wellbeing, fitness, or behavior-change products

Demonstrated ability to move from ambiguous, early-stage opportunity spaces to clear product direction and cross-functional execution

 Strong product judgment, balancing customer value, technical feasibility, design quality, and long-term product strategy

Excellent communication, storytelling, and stakeholder management skills, with experience leading through influence in complex, cross-functional environments

 Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

Pay & Benefits

At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $184,700 and $324,800, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location.

Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses - including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. Learn more about Apple Benefits

Note: Apple benefit, compensation and employee stock programs are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms of the applicable plan or program.

As the pace of the global consumer is rapidly changing all around the world, the Converse RPC looks to create inspiring products closer to the consumer. Deepening consumer connection and operating with speed, the GC (Greater China) RPC team aims to serve consumers with speed and specificity with a focus.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

We are seeking Designer II specializing in Footwear Product Design, who will collaborate closely with a cross-functional team including design, product management, and development partners. This position is based in Shanghai, China. The ideal candidate brings a strong background in designing shoes and is passionate about creating innovative footwear collections and franchises that reflect authentic local stories and consumer expression. In this role, you will focus on crafting distinctive, highly desirable shoes by integrating design expertise with materials, trims, and details, ensuring each product resonates with Streetwear and Lifestyle consumers in the local market. A keen eye for detail and a drive to produce premium footwear are essential. This role offers a unique opportunity to build a hyperlocal narrative and deliver a comprehensive style vision that specifically connects with Streetwear and Lifestyle shoe enthusiasts in Greater China (GC).

WHAT YOU WILL WORK ON

This designer will work with their cross-functional partners to understand the needs of the consumer and create an inspiring product narrative using market trend and local cultural insights. They will create a vision for Footwear collections by telling unique hyper local stories that resonate with Streetwear and Lifestyle consumers. They will make world class product expressions using Graphic and Color Design in collaboration with Materials, Trim and Development experts. Most importantly, they will craft unique, highly sought after product that connects on a deeper level.

If this is you, you'll be working with the Converse CTM team to design compelling Footwear products that bring energy to local markets.

Day-to-day tasks include consumer and trend research, project management, communicating design intent through presentations and mood boards, sketching and exploration, collaboration with other designers, design reviews, product CAD and tech pack creation.

WHO YOU WILL WORK WITH

You will be working with GC geography experts in insights, marketing, product, development and design. You will collaborate with functional experts and leadership in Color, Material, Graphic and Footwear and Apparel Product Design across various parts of the business.

WHAT YOU BRING

  • BA/BFA/MA/MFA/associate's degree in Product Design, graphic design, or related field preferred
  • 5+ years relevant work experience in Product Design, Graphic Design, Color Design,
  • Strong passion for research and gathering cultural and market insights
  • Effective communicator and collaborator with cross-functional partners
  • Proven ability to create concepts, iterate and collaborate with a multi-disciplinary product and creative team.
  • Understanding and ability to concepts based on a holistic head-to-toe design expression inclusive of footwear and apparel
  • Awareness of the Converse brand, its design ethos, and its cultural relevance
  • Connection to contemporary art & design, sport and streetwear trends
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and timelines
  • Creates graphics that are Industry leading, trend right and that consistently incorporate consumer/athlete insights through powerful storytelling, emotional connectivity and relevance
  • Produces presentation materials in conjunction with design and category teams that effectively communicate the concept behind the line for internal and external audiences
  • Proficient ability to apply and perform color and graphic design skills, including drawing/sketching, typography, ideation, color theory, use of texture, spacing, and scale, visual presentation development and layout that is supported by a portfolio of non-computer-based creative art and graphic design
  • Use advanced design skills to create original graphic and/or textile designs that appropriately reflect Converse brand design ethos
  • Computer literate using Mac platforms with a high digital design acumen in design-based software
  • Experience with 3D and AI Design tools is not required, but is a plus

Position Summary...

What you'll do...

Senior Manager, UX Design - Core Ecommerce

Location:San Bruno, CA

About the Team

Join our award-winning design team and help shape the future of retail. Our mission is to bring dignity and access to all through design excellenceregardless of zip code or bank account. We design compelling experiences that improve the daily lives of millions of customers, whether at home, in-store, or on the go.

As part of the design team at the forefront of retail innovation, you'll help build best-in-class experiences that drive continuous improvement for one of the worlds largest companies. If youre motivated by complex challenges and want to redefine commerce and consumer services, a design role at Walmart could be the opportunity youve been looking for.

About the Role

As aSenior UX Manager on the Core Ecommerce team, you will lead a team to articulate the strategy and design for key parts of the Walmart.com and mobile app shopping experiences, focused on building and mentoring your team and workflow for high impact results. You will use your deep understanding of consumer app patterns and retail experiences to transform how our customers complete their shopping missions in our app and on our site. You'll be accountable for the craft and timely delivery of your teams work, and you'll own and present a strong design POV within your partner set to shape market-leading solutions via the product roadmap.

You'll sweep us off our feet if you have...

  • Excellent visual and interaction design skills and a keen understanding of trendsin and out of retail.
  • An ability to communicate concepts in a clear and compelling way to audiences of all levels of understanding and levels of seniority.
  • A demonstrable understanding of ecommerce and deep experience building experiences that drive revenue.
  • A strong design aesthetic that brings together brand expressions and systems thinking. You practice universal design.
  • Deep experience with business requirement gathering, end-to-journey mapping, facilitating sessions like Design Sprints, conducting competitive analysis, and leading rapid concepting and prototyping.
  • Comfort with ambiguity along with an ability to motive teams and partners.
  • Ability to consume deep strategic data and insights to produce meaningful experiences for customers and members.
  • A demonstrable track record working cross-functionally with shipping successful products in a fast-paced environment. You thrive in an ever-changing environment.
  • A strategic mindset and asystemthinking approach to taking the complex and make it simple.
  • Find joy in leading by doing. You inspire, coach, and contribute to our team culture.
  • A self-starter mindset who is well organized and always looking to improve things.

You'll make an impact by:

  • Designing at the highest level of craftfor a broad population of Walmart customers.
  • Facilitating creative problem-solving across cross-functional partners to drive best-in-class thinking from all parts of the organization and seamlessly integrating competitive organizational goals.
  • Proactively soliciting, leveraging, and sharing design research, competitive research, data, and analytics to create full-featured and strategic products.
  • Owning and driving a program of work and collaborating seamlessly with cross-functional partners.
  • Recruiting the best design talent and mentoring our growing team.
  • Thinking holistically so that we build true end-to-end experiences.
  • Multitasking across different projects and adapting to changing priorities.
  • Championing the Design Thinking philosophy throughout the business.
  • Communicating effectively with kindness and empathy.

Preferred qualifications:

  • DegreeinHCI,Information Architecture,DigitalDesign,or similar and 7+ years of experience in product design.
  • Have afantastic portfolio of elegant design solutions.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication.

Eaton's ES AMER ESS division is currently seeking a Retrofill Materials Technician.

The expected annual salary range for this role is $47000 - $69000 a year.

Please note the salary information shown above is a general guideline only. Salaries are based upon candidate skills, experience, and qualifications, as well as market and business considerations.

What you'll do:

Primary function

The Switchgear Modernization division of EESS designs and manufactures custom solutions that allow for the modernization of both LV and MV equipment. The Retrofill Materials Technician is responsible for inventory control, material quality verification, and assembly of retrofill kits to support production and customer requirements. This role ensures materials are accurately received, stored, inventoried, inspected, and kitted while maintaining high standards for safety, quality, and operational excellence.

Essential functions

Receiving/Shipping Retrofill Kits

• Maintain accurate inventory levels of retrofill components, hardware, and materials
• Receive, identify, label, and store incoming materials according to established procedures
• Investigate and resolve inventory discrepancies
• Ship complete retrofill kits on time with customer schedule to accurate locations

Kitting Operations

• Assemble and verify retrofill kits according to engineering specifications, bill of materials, and work instructions
• Ensure kits are complete, accurate, and available to support production schedules and customer demand
• Stage and organize materials for efficient kit assembly and distribution
• Identify missing, damaged, or incorrect components and coordinate corrective actions
• Support continuous improvement initiatives to increase kitting efficiency

Quality

• Inspect materials and kits for accuracy, completeness, and compliance with quality standards
• Verify part numbers, quantities, revisions, and documentation before kit release
• Maintain clean and organized work areas in accordance with safety and quality requirements
• Understand and follow prescribed EESS safety policies, pertaining to shop and field environments
• Work with Electrical and Mechanical Engineer to solve customer control issues & requirements
• Participate and contribute to process improvements

Qualifications:

Basic Qualifications

  • High School Diploma or equivalent GED.
  • Eaton will not consider applicants for employment immigration sponsorship or support for this position. This means that Eaton will not support any CPT, OPT, or STEM OPT plans, F-1 to H-1B, H-1B cap registration, O-1, E-3, TN status, I-485 job portability, etc.
  • No relocation is offered for this position. Candidate must reside within 50 mile radius of Warrendale, PA to be considered

Preferred Qualifications

  • Associate's Degree in Supply Chain Management or an Engineering discipline.
  • Strong understanding of Vista and Mapics.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and Excel.
  • Strong understanding of quality procedures

#LI-CM1

Skills:

Specialized knowledge

• Basic mathematical skills.
• Ability to work overtime on short notice.
• Strong interpersonal skills with heavy emphasis on good communication skills (Oral and written).
• Strong mathematical skills.
• Computer skills surrounding Microsoft Office suite, Oracle and Planner.
• Excellent problem solving skills with a strong sense of urgency.
• Position requires high level of concentration and close attention to details.
• Ability to lift, push or pull up to 50 lbs, unassisted and throughout the day as needed.
• Continuous standing, bending, reaching, lifting, pushing and pulling.
• Requirement to train and qualify for power industrial truck (forklift) license.

Additional Information:

• Applicants must be willing to perform all aspects of product design & test. Frequent physical labor is required to assemble, verify, and test prototype samples.

• Applicants must successfully complete EESS safety training to operate at customer sites. Applicants must adhere to all EESS safety programs and policies.

• A valid driver's license is required.

• Willingness to work with basic hand tools and work in a shop environment is essential.

• Willingness to learn basic controls theory and wiring practices.

Dimensions

• This position will directly contribute to increased sales volume and generate additional pull-through for EESS DOCs.

• Generation and installation of new designs for the market will broaden the EESS Solution set and improve Eaton's position as a premier electrical distribution manufacturer.
